headline: GAAP profit dips on charges; adjusted metrics hold steady
summary_short: Franklin Resources reported net income of $171.5M ($0.31 diluted EPS) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, down 36.1% q/q on one-off charges but up 85.8% y/y, as revenue grew 14.3% y/y to $2.36B.
summary_long: Revenue rose 2.8% q/q and 14.3% y/y to $2.36B on higher investment-management, distribution and servicing fees. GAAP net income fell 36.1% q/q to $171.5M ($0.31 diluted EPS), fully attributable to one-off items excluded from non-GAAP figures: a $100.0M regulatory-settlement charge, $77.2M of special termination benefits, and a $33.0M impairment. Adjusted net income was roughly flat q/q at $386.3M ($0.72 adjusted diluted EPS), and both net income and EPS rose sharply y/y (+85.8%, +106.7%) on lower amortization and higher other income. Total AUM hit a record $1.79 trillion on $18.4B of long-term net inflows; the company repurchased $348.1M of stock. No numeric forward guidance was given.
